sloka: तपनीय गव अक्षाणि मणि जाल आवृतानि च ।पुष्पिताः फालवन्तः च पुण्याः सुरभि गन्धयः ॥४-५१-६॥
transliteration: tapanīya gava akṣāṇi maṇi jāla āvṛtāni ca ।puṣpitāḥ phālavantaḥ ca puṇyāḥ surabhi gandhayaḥ ॥4-51-6॥

translations.english: 'By whose prowess are these golden trees yielding sacred fragrant flowers and fruits? How are these golden lotuses created in the clear water? How is it that here are golden fishes and tortoises? Whose fruit of penance is this? Is it by your power? We do not know. You should tell all of us everything'.
translations.hindi: उनके मित्र राजा सुग्रीव हैं जो बड़े वीर हैं। उन्हीं वानरों के राजा सुग्रीव ने हमको सीता को ढू ढ़ने के लिए भेजा हे
